summary:
Reused the inspected prior GodExists/root/premise dossiers, refreshed related GodExists search and inspected new ExistingInActAt and EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround dossiers before implementation. No new statement, definition, relation, source claim or model is introduced in this slice; the direct esse predicate was already implemented and its new record is owned by the companion interface/uniqueness slice. DirectEsseRootRoute.maximumExistsOfExistingRoot and maximumEqualsRoot supply existence/identity of maxima for a supplied actual concrete root under explicit existing-to-esse, genus, direct esse-to-ground, grades-to-maximum and EM. godOfRoot derives maximum-to-firstness internally from that identity and supplied firstness, then imports CausalPerfectionTransfer.reducedDescription for the retained actuality-to-being, universal-source transfer, no-component/remoteness and full nominal naming calculation. The thirteen-input route imports NecessaryFirstBeing.necessaryFirst and retains rootness, necessary existence, firstness and God of the SAME n in its helper before projecting GodExists. Its frozen Challenge SHA2562508dd4f766aaea130ac42c968a6575af0402069960b1ee479f112d5898c7e83 precedes Solution. The separately frozen twelve-input ExistenceOnly Challenge SHA256446574afb460bf3f6f0a45878baa7dcd14b2cdb30251118a58810cc1a2f888f1 removes contingent dependence: WholeRosterFoundation.actualRootExists supplies an actual root directly, and the same priority correspondence supplies firstness. Its helper retains actual rootness/firstness/God but NO NecessaryAt property. Both advertised conclusions are exactly existing GodExists. Removing contingent dependence is a genuine input removal for that conclusion, not a derivation of necessary existence without it. Compared with the earlier fourteen-input modal route, direct esse replaces necessary-being actuality and both necessity-cause interfaces with ExistingInActAt and EsseCauseIsActualConcreteGround. The latter covers actual contingent targets, unlike the old necessity-only correspondence; no global logical weakness/equivalence or philosophical discharge is claimed. Rejected shortcuts: no new max(n), independent max uniqueness, global max-to-firstness premise, God-to-maximum converse, pure-act-to-God bridge, or identification of direct esse causation with ordinary m.Causes. Every nominal/causal applicability commitment remains explicit. Focused worker_env Lean checking passes for both Solutions; integration binding, Comparator, NanoDa and exact frontier comparison remain coordinator-owned. Both original frozen Challenges are preserved; prior 16/14 routes are untouched. Shared convention sourceRevision625cb04ca568aebc8d45c90033e107a05e9bd2a0. All five helper/exported axiom reports are empty. Existing transcription heuristics do not flag either result as a single-premise application or tuple assembly; the final nominal application remains an explicit open commitment. Corpus and whitespace checks pass. Coordinator full build passes (4280 jobs), exact binding reports777 bound/2existing pins/0mismatch; all4newresults and3affected existing whole-roster results pass zero-permitted-axiom Comparator and independent NanoDa. Measured vs main22e1cfe8: GodExists adds cost11/direct12 and cost12/direct13, GodIsOne adds cost6/direct7, unique necessary actual root adds cost7/direct8. Existing routes unchanged; God/GodIsOne unions64→66 and16→18 add only ExistingInActAt and direct esse-ground correspondence; Catholic union73 unchanged. These measurements neither establish premise truth nor globally weaker coverage than earlier necessity-only bundles. SourceRevision625cb04ca568aebc8d45c90033e107a05e9bd2a0.

The full antecedent supplies substantial unique ultimate-source content and prima facie direct identification warrant; stipulative naming or the already checked nominal/classical equivalence adds no independent warrant. Outgoing noncomponenthood does not imply inward simplicity or genus transcendence. Retained Spinozist substance/mode mechanism motivates the latter without certifying full antecedent fit; necessitarian effects are a substantive commitment, conflicting only with independently warranted contingency, not with the naming antecedent. Divine proposals receive identical causal/mode/scope restrictions. No new proof or formal vocabulary; unchanged formal evidence reused. All attribute, selection, existence and productive applicability burdens remain. Complete provisional judgment, rejected approaches and self-sweep retained in the linked existing note.

No modal necessity, intellect, will, inward simplicity or genus transcendence follows merely from this naming antecedent. Direct primitive and cumulative support remain available; no premise discharge.
